final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS acct, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS c FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), ov AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_c FROM g), gd AS (SELECT g.acct, g.region, g.c, g.c - ov.avg_c AS diff FROM g JOIN ov ON ov.avg_c IS NOT NULL), ra AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS reg_avg FROM gd GROUP BY region) SELECT gd.acct, gd.region, gd.c, gd.diff, gd.diff - ra.reg_avg AS final_diff FROM gd JOIN ra ON ra.region = gd.region WHERE gd.diff > ra.reg_avg ORDER BY final_diff IS NULL, final_diff DESC LIMIT 10
